description: This file contains multiple mixins related to gradient backgrounds, including linear and radial gradients, directional gradients, multi-color gradients, and striped patterns. It is used to generate reusable CSS background styles with various gradient effects.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Applies a background color or gradient if enabled.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient between two colors with specified start and end percentages.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient between two colors, with optional start and end positions.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified angle between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient with three colors positioned at specified stops.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient with three colors at a specified position.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient between two colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern with transparent and colored segments at a specified angle.
